summary: Configured node1 so new interactive login shells use umask 027. The setting persisted through a verified node reboot.

Restarted node1 safely and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified system health, SSH availability, configuration integrity, and login behavior after restart.

evidence.requirement: Default umask 027 for new interactive login sessions
evidence.summary: Shows the persistent configuration and successful pre- and post-restart login tests for both regular and root users.
Captures the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, restored system/SSH health, unchanged configuration hash, and recovered umask behavior.
